hmmt-feb-2006-calc-01.prompt: A nonzero polynomial $f(x)$ with real coefficients has the property that $f(x)=f'(x)f''(x)$. What is the leading coefficient of $f(x)$?

hmmt-feb-2006-calc-03.prompt: At time $0$, an ant is at $(1,0)$ and a spider is at $(-1,0)$. The ant starts walking counterclockwise along the unit circle, and the spider starts creeping to the right along the $x$-axis. It so happens that the ant's horizontal speed is always half the spider's. What will the shortest distance ever between the ant and the spider be?

hmmt-feb-2006-calc-06.prompt: A triangle with vertices at $(1003,0)$, $(1004,3)$, and $(1005,1)$ in the $xy$-plane is revolved all the way around the $y$-axis. Find the volume of the solid thus obtained.

hmmt-feb-2006-calc-07.prompt: Find all positive real numbers $c$ such that the graph of $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ given by $f(x)=x^3-cx$ has the property that the circle of curvature at any local extremum is centered at a point on the $x$-axis.

hmmt-feb-2006-calc-09.prompt: Compute the sum of all real numbers $x$ such that $$2x^6-3x^5+3x^4+x^3-3x^2+3x-1=0.$$

hmmt-feb-2006-calc-10.prompt: Suppose $f$ and $g$ are differentiable functions such that $$x\,g(f(x))\,f'(g(x))\,g'(x)=f(g(x))\,g'(f(x))\,f'(x)$$ for all real $x$. Moreover, $f$ is nonnegative and $g$ is positive. Furthermore, $$\int_0^af(g(x))\,dx=1-\frac{e^{-2a}}{2}$$ for all reals $a$. Given that $g(f(0))=1$, compute the value of $g(f(4))$.
